problem_summary: 10 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Pattabhiram Nagar between January 2019 and September 2021, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 20% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 10 of 10 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.32). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, complaint_volume=0.33, unresolved_rate=0.20.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Pattabhiram Nagar' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Pattabhiram Nagar for the period 2019–2021.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
